situation: I feel very cut off and detached from my family, who lives many miles away from me in another state.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hello.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi how are you doing today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I'm alright, just feeling a bit depressed.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Im sorry you are feeling depressed. Whats making you feel that way?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thanksgiving is this week and I will be spending it alone.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Youre spending thanksgiving alone? Do you usually spend Thanksgiving alone?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, and no because of COVID I haven't been able to see my family.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I understand how you feel. COVID is causing a lot of distance between familys making relationships difficult.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Have you thought about video chatting them on Thanksgiving?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes very. My family lives in another state.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, but it's not the same.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I know what you mean, in-person is always better than over the phone. I understand why you would feel this way.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It's made me feel very depressed and I am only feeling worse as the holiday grows closer.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You're not alone in feeling this way. A lot of people are missing their families during the holidays. What would help you during this difficult times? besides video chatting? Can you still cook yourself a nice meal and do any traditions you normally do?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes I could do that. I was thinking about ordering a Thanksgiving Platter for 2 people so I could have some leftovers from a restaurant that I really like in my town.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: They do holiday specials.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: thats a great idea!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: And AMC always shows great holiday movies so I will watch a bunch.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: dont worry, soon this pandemic will end and we can go back to the holidays we are used to. We just have to wait. I understand how hard it can make it on holidays though.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes I do hope so.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I love AMC/Holiday  movies as well!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I understand the situation is dire and people are sick, but everyone is suffering, even emotionally.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: that is very true. our world has been so different this year

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes it's sad.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Is there any foods you are looking forward to from your favorite restraunt or movie your interested to watch this year?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes of course. Mashed potatoes and gravy and the movie Four Christmases is hysterical.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: great choices! mashed potatoes and gravy is my favorite too! and that movie is so funny.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haha thanks. Well thank you for chatting with me, I feel better.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You sound like you have a great plan in place as a temporary holiday until we can be with our familes again. i know its not the same but you sound like you are making the best of the situation. which is all we can really do .

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you. I'm trying. I really miss my parents.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: im glad you are feeling better and glad we could chat!
